Sandbox_HARMONIE_ModernFirearmsSystemFix: Multiplies how often ModernFirearmsSystem's own ~230 guns and ammo items appear in loot, on top of the mod's own hardcoded weights (it ships with no rate control of its own, only per-gun on/off toggles). 1.0 = the mod's own unmodified rate. 0 = never spawns (same as disabling every per-gun toggle). Does not affect vanilla loot or this mod's weapon attachments/parts.
